sloka: स हि देशः तु वध्यस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।राक्षस अधिपतेः वासः सहस्राक्ष समद्युतेः ॥४-४१-२५॥
transliteration: sa hi deśaḥ tu vadhyasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ।rākṣasa adhipateḥ vāsaḥ sahasrākṣa samadyuteḥ ॥4-41-25॥

translations.english: There above all Sita must be searched for with all effort, for that region is the abode of the wicked Ravana, lord of demons, who deserves death and rivals thousand-eyed Indra in splendour.
